title: One call of step 9b to the site agent is cut at two minutes, not at the end of the repair window
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: REPAIR_LIMITS.callMs is two minutes, and a call with no limit of its own that never answers fails at callMs with '<what> did not answer in the time left'.
Near the return a call gets only the time left; a call given its own limit keeps it; a call that answers in time gives its value.

tests: a call that never answers is cut at callMs, two minutes, not at the end of the repair window
near the return, a call gets only the time left, and an explicit limit is kept
